INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR AGREEMENT

This Independent Contractor Agreement is made between Brightside Media Inc. ("Client") and Jordan Ellis ("Contractor").

1. SERVICES. Contractor will design and deliver the website described in Exhibit A.

2. PAYMENT. Client will pay Contractor a fixed fee of $4,500, with half due on signing and half on delivery. Invoices are payable within thirty days.

3. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY. All work product created under this Agreement belongs to Client once Client has paid in full.

4. INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR. Contractor is not an employee of Client and is responsible for their own taxes and equipment.

5. TERMINATION. Either party may end this Agreement with fourteen days' written notice.
